items.body: - Added Claude Haiku 5.5 (`claude-haiku-5-5`), now the default Haiku model on the Anthropic API — 1M context, $0.10/$0.50 per Mtok ($0.50/$2.50 for prompts over 100K) - Added `agentType` to the `subagentStatusLine` payload, so scripts can tell custom subagent types apart - Fixed Claude sometimes treating its own last actions before a context compaction as done after it, and retracting or redoing finished work - Fixed a memory leak where an HTTP MCP connection kept every request it had sent until it closed
